texts.notes: Only B (with descripti M V R U, recorded under B) is a full direct witness; C and A are excerpt collections, G a cento poem, Eug Eugenius' reworking of book I; Eug/G cover book I only, A books II-III only. texts.notes: Grouping V+D rests on 'frater' (common parent) and on V, D being unrelated to the Spanish exemplar behind Eugenius; the diagram survives in OCR only as 'Dracontius / V D'. D is a fragment (v. 1-80) and Eug a free reworking, so V is the only full direct witness. Check p. XXIX diagram.

texts.notes: Editor states four independent sources (Λ, L, M, Φ) and explicitly declines any higher grouping, so k_E = 4 with three single-witness branches. Each source has a different selection of poems (Λ fragmentary). Lips. is assigned to Ψ or Φ; Brux. said to go back to a fuller exemplar (not placed) and Harl. not placed: both left out of the branches. Ma/Mb may or may not share an exemplar (p. XLV n. 3).
